title: Three things we
noticed about Salt Gypsy
Three things
we noticed
about Salt Gypsy
sections.kicker: Prepared for Salt Gypsy by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Salt Gypsy's pink hero says who it is. The words around it do not.
sections.keep: The hand-lettered orange logo. It is playful and nobody else has anything like it.

pins.what: The only words under the hero are instructions.
pins.why: The film shows a pink ring on grass and pink heels. The words say nothing about what Salt Gypsy believes or why it is not the shoe label next door.
pins.how: Put one sentence about the Salt Gypsy world under the film.
pins.label: Your words
pins.cost: The page shows a mood and never claims it.

pins.area: The beige bars and black pill buttons around the pink poolside hero film
pins.what: The pink, poolside, summer feeling stops at the hero. The bars and pills around it are beige and black.
pins.why: The film is the brand. The frame around it is any online shop.
pins.how: Bring the pink and the playfulness into the frame.
pins.label: Your frame
pins.cost: The brand lives in one film and nowhere else on the page.

pins.what: Mystery boxes lead the menu, ahead of the shop itself.
pins.why: Buying shoes in a box you open to find out what is inside is an idea the shop next door does not have. It is listed as a menu label with no explanation.
pins.how: Tell the mystery box story on the front door.
pins.label: Your menu
pins.cost: Your most ownable idea is easy to walk past.
